summary: Read a grid of 9 rows and 9 columns. A cell holds a digit from 1 through 9, or a dot when it is blank. Decide whether the digits already written conflict with each other. Blank cells may be ignored, and you need not decide whether the grid can later be completed. In any row, any column, and any block of 3 rows by 3 columns, a digit may be written at most once. Write yes when this holds, and write no otherwise.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
